title: Think It Out Escape Rooms
specs: Nothing scary or obscene; suitable for all ages
Mobile Escape Games available for events
Minimum of 4 players per room; max varies by game, up to 12
Recommended age 8+, but designed for ages 18+; participants 17 and under must be accompanied by an adult
Each room requires a minimum of 4 people, some games max 12 players
Private games only; no strangers paired together
Special consideration for solo play may be made; contact for info
Flexible timing for groups; off-hour Special Games on request
includes: All puzzles, clues, and game materials provided in the room
Briefing and debriefing, optional team photo opportunities
blurb: Think It Out Escape Rooms offers a variety of escape games for friends, families, and colleagues at their Fraser, MI location. Each game involves solving puzzles and clues within 60 minutes to 'escape' the room. All games are private, not paired with strangers, and are designed to be fun challenges rather than scary or physically demanding. Special arrangements can be made for off-hours games and events.
extraNote: All bookings are non-refundable; at least 48 hours' notice required to reschedule · No refunds for no-shows · 16658 15 Mile Road, Fraser, MI 48026 (in the Kingston Office Center)
